name: ccp
description: Code Collaboration Platform toolkit: the ship-pr skill ships uncommitted work end to end (branch, commit, PR, an ADR when architecturally significant, and a merge that only happens after you explicitly confirm it), the resolve-conflicts skill syncs a branch with its target and resolves conflicts into a mergeable state, the triage-issues skill fetches and ranks open issues/project items and hands a picked one to ship-pr, the propose-skill skill scans the current conversation for a repeatable pattern and files a GitHub issue against the marketplace repo requesting it be built, a Stop hook nudges you when work is left unshipped, and /issues, /actions, /prs, /pr, /repo and /project commands open the matching GitHub or GitLab view via gh or glab.
